texts.preamble: Rama Shankar Prasad vs State Of Bihar & Anr on 16 July, 2015 Author: Vikash Jain Bench: Vikash Jain In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna Criminal Miscellaneous No.14356 of 2013 Arising Out of PS.Case No. -14 Year- 2010 Thana -Government Official Comp. Distr Aurangabad =========================================================== Rama Shankar Prasad, son of Late Sita Ram Sao, resident of village Audarbazar, Aurangabad, P.S.Aurangabad, Dist. Aurangabad. .... .... Petitioner/s Versus State of Bihar & Anr .... .... Opposite Party/s =========================================================== Appearance: For the Petitioner/s : Mr. N.K.Agrawal, Sr.Advocate Mr. D.N.Tiwary, Advocate Mr. Sanjeet Kumar, Advocate For the Opposite Party/s : App =========================================================== Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Vikash Jain Oral Judgment
texts.facts: 2. The present petition has been filed for quashing the order dated 25.02.2010 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aurangabad in connection with G.O. Case No. 14 of 2010 for the offences under Sections 16(1) (a) (i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the analysis report dated 07.12.2009 issued by the Combined Food & Drug Laboratory, Agam Kuan, Patna as contained in Annexure-5 of the petition, merely discloses the presence of water soluble colours and it is opined that the sample of Masur Dal does not conform to the prescribed standard of purity Rama Shankar Prasad vs State Of Bihar & Anr on 16 July, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135755907/ 1 laid down under the P.F.A. Rules and hence adulterated. It is howev submitted that there is nothing in the said report to suggest that such the Patna High Court Cr.Misc. No.14356 of 2013 dt.16-07-2015 water soluble colour was of a nature injurious to health or otherwise for human consumption and as such the petitioner ought not to be prosecuted. 4. This Court has considered this aspect of the matter in a nu decisions including Cr. Misc. No. 16358 of 2010 disposed of on 06.01. (Awadh Bihari Lal vs. The State of Bihar), Cr. Misc. No. 16282 of 201 disposed of on 03.08.2012 (Binod Kumar Agrawal vs. The State of Bihar Cr. Misc. No.48446 of 2012 disposed of on 14.05.2015 ( Sitaram Khaita anr. vs. The State of Bihar) including 2010 (3) PLJR 120 (Rajeev Kuma State of Bihar).
